_comment: Workbook exercise mv-baselines (docs/workbook/mv-baselines.md), part 3: SEP chaining through 2019 onto 2020, with the spring 2020 school and kindergarten closure (12 March to 11 May 2020, the dataset's covid-19-closures-2020 data issue) as a non-routine adjustment: an indicator estimated on the 2020 days against the intermediate model (fit_period 'reporting'). The evidence and approval fields are filled because validity 'both' (SEP section 5.3.2) requires them; the approver 'workbook' marks it as a teaching example. Three cofactor-drammen main meters (ElImp): two schools, b6400 (3,958 m2) and b6404 (6,570 m2), and a nursing home, b6410 (3,327 m2), building categories from the publisher's file headers. Each meter's own outdoor temperature (the oat role stored on the meter) drives a daily change-point + occupied-day model (Monday to Friday except Norway's public holidays, the bundled NO calendar), as in the dataset template; validity 'both' reports the G14 acceptance and the SEP 50001 section 6.4.1 validity side by side. No energy measure is documented in these years, so a saving here is a change nobody has explained.

adjustments.evidence: national closure from 12 March 2020, staged reopening to 11 May 2020 (dataset data issue covid-19-closures-2020)
